final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT a.account_id AS account_id, c.town_city AS town_city, COUNT(ft.transaction_id) AS cnt FROM Accounts a LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON a.account_id = ft.account_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id GROUP BY a.account_id, c.town_city), s2 AS (SELECT town_city AS town_city, SUM(cnt) AS total FROM s1 GROUP BY town_city), s3 AS (SELECT s1.account_id AS account_id, s1.town_city AS town_city, s1.cnt AS cnt, CASE WHEN s2.total = 0 THEN NULL ELSE 1.0 * s1.cnt / s2.total END AS ratio FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s1.town_city = s2.town_city), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM s3) SELECT s3.account_id, s3.town_city, s3.cnt, s3.ratio, CASE WHEN s4.avg_cnt = 0 THEN NULL ELSE 1.0 * s3.cnt / s4.avg_cnt END AS rel FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rel DESC LIMIT 10
